headline: CCPA fines Britannia ₹1 lakh for misleading whole wheat bread claims
hook: Misleading whole wheat claim draws penalty
summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority has penalized Britannia Industries ₹1 lakh for marketing a bread as 100% whole wheat when it contained only 62% whole wheat. The company has also been directed to submit a compliance report within 15 days. For Indian retail investors, the fine itself has a negligible financial impact on a large-cap company, but regulatory scrutiny on product labeling poses reputational risks.
why_it_matters: Minimal financial impact, but highlights rising regulatory scrutiny on labeling.
